settings.title: Settings
settings.autoConnect: Automatically connect to the last LouvorJA when the app starts
settings.runInBackgroundTesting: Feature under testing, still off in this version.

libras.title: Libras translator
libras.onlineHint: Slide text is sent to the server configured below. Whatever was already translated is kept on this computer and works offline.
libras.invalidUrl: Enter a valid http:// or https:// address.
libras.refreshError: Could not download the catalog. Check the address and your connection.

catalog.description: The list of signs that exist. It is used to check each word and to let the translator on this computer find the infinitive of verbs and the singular of nouns.

dictionary.title: Sign dictionary
dictionary.description: Where the signs the avatar makes come from. Each sign is downloaded once and then works without internet.

avatar.cacheEmpty: None yet. Each sign is downloaded once and then works offline.

errors.apiUnavailable: This application must run inside Electron.

form.title: Connection
form.hostInvalid: Enter a valid IP or name, without http://, port or slashes.
form.portInvalid: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
form.tokenHint: Shown in the Transmitir tab of LouvorJA. Not needed on the same computer.
form.tokenInvalid: The token can only have letters and numbers.

status.idle: Enter the LouvorJA address and connect.

errors.unreachable: Could not reach LouvorJA. Check the address, the port and that LouvorJA is running.
errors.timeout: LouvorJA did not answer in time.
errors.closed: The connection to LouvorJA was closed.
errors.unauthorized: LouvorJA refused the token. Check the token shown in the Transmitir tab.
errors.incompatible: The address answered, but it does not look like the LouvorJA transmission server. Check the address and port.

help.title: How to connect
help.text: In LouvorJA, open the Transmitir tab and click Iniciar Servidor. Enter here the address, the port and the token it shows. If LouvorJA is on this computer, leave the token empty.

slides.title: Slides
slides.emptyHint: Connect to LouvorJA and start a presentation.

libras.title: Libras gloss

sourceHints.manual: Written or corrected by a person.
sourceHints.cache: Translated before and kept on this computer.
sourceHints.local: Simplified translation, made on this computer.
sourceHints.online: Translated just now by the VLibras server.
sourceHints.fallback: No automatic translation: just the slide words, without Libras grammar.

availability.spelled: No sign of its own: it will be fingerspelled
availability.missing: No sign and it cannot be fingerspelled

libras.editHint: Upper-case words separated by spaces. Use _ for compound signs (ESPÍRITO_SANTO).
libras.fallbackHint: Automatic translation is off. Turn on the online translator in Settings or edit the gloss by hand.
libras.localHint: Simplified translation made on this computer: it can get verbs, plurals and words with more than one meaning wrong. Turn on the online translator in Settings for the full translation, or edit the gloss by hand.
libras.catalogHint: The sign catalog has not been downloaded yet. Without it there is no way to know which signs exist, and the translation on this computer does not put verbs in the infinitive or nouns in the singular.

projection.title: Projection
projection.noGloss: No gloss to interpret yet. Use "Test avatar" to see it in action.
projection.unavailableHint: The avatar player was not downloaded. Run "npm run player:fetch" while online and open the app again.
projection.errorHint: The avatar took too long or failed to start.
projection.showSlide: Show the slide in the background

overlay.title: Over the presentation (overlay)
overlay.description: A transparent window, always on top and click-through, shows the avatar over the LouvorJA presentation. Use it on the big screen or the audience monitor.
overlay.singleScreen: Only one screen is connected: the avatar will sit over everything on it. Plug in the projector to pick another.
overlay.autoOpen: Open the overlay when the app starts
overlay.onlyDuringPresentation: Show the avatar only during the presentation

projection.delayHint: Delaying waits a little longer even once the signs are already ready. A head start shortens how long the avatar waits for the signs to download before starting anyway. Counted from the moment the slide goes on the air. Applies to every slide (and to the overlay).

manual.title: Manual
manual.description: How to use each part of the app, and check for a newer version.
manual.openHint: How to use each part of the app

connection.title: Connection
connection.text: Connect to LouvorJA to receive slides automatically and sign them in Libras.

slides.title: Slides
slides.text: Shows the current slide, live, and the history of the last ones received from LouvorJA.

projection.title: Projection
projection.text: Choose the avatar (Ícaro, Guga or Hosana), see how it is being projected, and adjust speed, position, size and opacity.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Language, theme, the Libras translator (local or online) and the overlay - the transparent window that shows the avatar over any program.

updates.checkHint: Check whether a newer version is available
updates.unavailable: No update server is configured yet.
